name: Easy Slow Cooker Salsa Verde Chicken Tacos with Lettuce, Pickled Onions & Cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Place salsa verde, green chiles, garlic, and spices in the insert of a 4-quart slow cooker, then stir to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (16 oz) jar salsa verde
1 (4 oz) can diced green chiles, canned
2 tbsp minced garlic
1 tsp onion powder
1 tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels and add to the slow cooker, nestling thighs into the sauce. Cover and cook until chicken is tender, LOW for 5-6 hours.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: When the chicken is done, turn off the heat, then use two forks to shred the meat. Re-cover the salsa verde chicken and set aside.
Wash, dry, and shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Use a slotted spoon to fill tortillas with chicken filling. Top with lettuce, sour cream, pickled onions, and cilantro. Serve with sauce for dipping (optional) and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups shredded lettuce
½ cup sour cream
1 cup pickled red onions
